How to Apply
We encourage those contemplating graduate studies at Brigham Young University to visit the Graduate Studies website. This website contains the latest information regarding graduate studies at BYU and the application process. The information below summarizes the application process, but is not complete.
APPLY NOW
Application Deadlines:
Fall Semester (September start) - December 15th
Winter Semester (January start) - August 15th
Department Requirements for Admission
Requirements for admission are set by the university and by the Mechanical Engineering Department. For university requirements visit the Graduate Studies website. The following are departmental requirements:
BS degree in mechanical engineering or an allied field (engineering, physical, or mathematical sciences).
Statement of Intent
Resume
3 Letters of Recommendation
(Optional) Graduate Records Exam (GRE): Applicants may voluntarily submit GRE scores if they would like to provide an additional data point for faculty to consider when reviewing applications.
International students must follow University requirements regarding English Proficiency exams. Visit this site for additional information.
